digest.component_or_area: completion-verification gate, LLM agent tool-loop guard and memoization layer
propositions: the runaway-guard layer counts memo-served (cached) file reads as loop evidence despite the memo layer making them free, causing legitimate verification runs to abort with RunawayToolLoopError
guard and memo layers conflict in composition order: guard (outermost) observes and penalizes all calls before the memo layer can serve them from cache, defeating the memo's repeat-suppression design
memo-served repeats accumulate in the guard's distinct-ratio window and trigger the trip threshold even though they incur zero execution cost and no repo round-trips

a new shared ToolCallLedger tracks only EXECUTED tool calls (not memo-served repeats) and resets a served-streak counter when real work occurs, allowing the guard to distinguish cached hits from genuine loops
completion-policy evidence banking manufactures false met=false verdicts at search exhaustion rather than marking insufficient_evidence, conflating epistemic uncertainty with substantive failure
